content: If no signs of retinopathy are detected and blood sugar levels are well-controlled, it may be appropriate to schedule eye examinations every 1 to 2 years. However, if retinopathy is identified or shows signs of progression, more frequent examinations are strongly recommended. In the context of teleophthalmology, retinal imaging supported by artificial intelligence can serve as a cost-effective option for initial screenings, particularly in regions where access to ophthalmologists is limited.
